schema.run: flags, paths, seeds, sample sizes, tasks run and equal-time definitions of this run
schema.sample: stage-1 counts, kept set (names), drop reasons, tasks skipped in a reduced run, per-task n / patients / class counts
schema.diagnostics_summary: per arm: medians over kept recordings of the rate-fidelity diagnostics, Pearson r of median RR vs annotation, offset SD (signed, matched pairs) and IQR of per-recording median |offset|, detector paths (A), fusion statistics (B), annotation gaps (D), annotated coverage (E2). Sign convention: median_offset_ms = arm cycle start minus annotated S1 onset (negative = arm precedes S1); arm_mean_syn_ac_offset_ms = acoustic S1 onset minus synthetic R-peak (positive = acoustic onset follows R)
schema.global_offset_ms: offset maximising S1-onset agreement for arms A and B (verbatim best_offset); negative = peak precedes S1
schema.arms.<task>.<arm>: n, n_patients, majority baseline, and for mlp / rf: accuracy, macro_f1, balanced_accuracy, sensitivity and specificity per class (all in %), auroc and auprc (0-1), *_ci = 95% patient-bootstrap percentile interval over the valid resamples (n_boot_valid; [null, null] when fewer than 10), confusion_matrix (rows = truth), fold_* = per-fold scores, fit_info = early-stopping record per fold
schema.paired.<task>.<X-Y>.<clf>: pairs A-E, B-E, C-E, D-E, B-A, C-A, C-B, C-D (annotated phases against fixed fractions on the same cycle starts), A-D (synthetic against annotated anchors under the same fixed fractions), A-E2, B-E2, C-E2, E2-E; X minus Y on macro_f1 and accuracy: point estimate, bootstrap mean, 95% CI, P(diff>0) over the finite paired draws (n_boot_valid) from the same patient resamples; fold_ttest = scipy ttest_rel over the per-fold scores
schema.validation_gate: sample check (per-task n and patients against the reference run) and arm C / arm E macro-F1 under the reference recipe (ReferenceMLP, TF32 on) against the mechanism-study values; a cell is within when |delta| <= GATE_TOL or the reference value lies inside the 95% patient-bootstrap interval of the gate value (ci, within per cell); refset = the same on the reference-rule set when the kept set differs
schema.stage_seconds: wall-clock seconds per stage in this session
schema.units: rates in percent (0-100); auroc / auprc in [0,1]; offsets in ms; RR in ms

reference_mlp_cfg.loss: focal gamma 2.0 with inverse-frequency class weights
reference_mlp_cfg.tf32: on during the gate fits, as in the reference run

equal_time_definitions.equal_time: equal_time_cycles (verbatim, analysis source): fixed 75 bpm pseudo-cycles, four equal quarters; the mechanism study control used by the validation gate
equal_time_definitions.equal_time_matched: get_nongated_cycles (verbatim, ABLATION_GATING_VALIDATION.ipynb): the analysed portion cut into N equal pseudo-cycles, N = annotated cycles of arm C inside that portion, four equal quarters, seconds -> samples by int(t*sr); the published control, which inherits the annotated count and not the annotated rate

equal_time_matched.note: E2 inherits the annotated cycle count, not the annotated rate; its implied bpm falls with the coverage fraction
